reviews.title: Fuel Forward App

reviews.title: Mediocre at Best
reviews.text:
I cannot understand how this mediocre app gets such raving reviews. It frequently takes 10 full minutes to authorize payments at pumps, the station locator is extremely slow and is very sensitive to zoom level and panning. It will show zero stations in one view but if you pan or zoom even slightly, stations will appear. The only reason I bother with this app is because I’m currently getting 30 cents off every gallon of renewable diesel I pump if I use this app. Did they even test this app?

Tip: The pump will authorize much quicker if you use a credit card to pay instead of Apple Pay.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: So when I first started using this app, it was actually good and helped me save money on gas but now it’s just a waste of space on my phone(which I’m about to delete off of it). For whatever reason it does not show stores that support the app. It’ll show any in all Phillip 66/conoco/76 gas stations, but it doesn’t show the ones that actually support being used by the app. And I’ve used the app so far from here to Oklahoma and Kansas and what not.

reviews.title: Scam for your personal information
reviews.text: I added my card through the app specifically because of the advertised discount. Attempted to use it both at the pump and in store but was told the payment failed and the transaction declined for the discounted price. Of course my card worked with no issues at the higher price. Thanks for nothing, they’ll be happy to use the personal information I provided of course.
